summary: The six-sample independent AQCat25 TS-domain bootstrap was explicitly reviewed and registered for the exact checkpoint, SIGMA=0.20 eV compatibility hash, and Fe(110) C*+H*->CH* path neighborhood; the controller is now ready for work-side VASP refinement strategy selection.

payload.objective: Use the calibrated complete GPU path evidence to select the least-cost reliable VASP refinement route for Fe(110) C*+H*->CH*.

The accepted force limits are component MAE 0.05, vector RMSE 0.15, vector P95 0.30, and vector maximum 0.45 eV/A.

payload.one_executable_step: Run the unified work-side strategy review over the calibrated GPU path, continuity evidence, peak neighborhood, and exact VASP force labels to choose ordinary/micro-NEB, CI-NEB, or DIMER; prepare the chosen route for review without submitting it.
payload.submission_boundary: Calibration registration authorizes strategy selection only; any new GPU or VASP calculation still requires its normal review, execution gate, and explicit submission authorization.
done_when: The calibrated GPU path and exact VASP label evidence produce one hash-bound refinement recommendation through the unified TS strategy rules.
The recommended VASP route passes structure, path-continuity, compatibility, and execution-gate preflight.
The user reviews the prepared VASP refinement inputs before submission.
